{{Otheruses|Smuggler's Run}}
The '''Smuggler's Run''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a population of [[Ni'lyahin Smugglers]] set their quarters in the Smuggler's Run, hoping to harvest pieces from the Death Star's explosion and sell it on the black market.
